name: breadcrumbs
purpose: Agent-operations machinery for a repo you cannot afford to break: memory ledgers, retrieval measurement, CI guards, merge-gate workflows, and the pattern docs behind them.
distribution_note: There is deliberately no pip/npm package. Every file is meant to be copied into your repo, owned, and edited; a package would make our release cadence your dependency and fight the adapt step. This manifest exists so a developer or their agent can adopt programmatically anyway: resolve a problem to artifacts, copy them, run their selftests.

requires.python: >=3.9, stdlib only (no dependencies anywhere in the kit)
requires.platform_assumptions: git repo; GitHub Actions for the workflow templates; Claude Code for the command/hook templates (adapt for other harnesses)

verify_all: Run every selftest below; each is offline, stdlib-only, and exits nonzero on failure. CI runs the same set (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

artifacts.what: Retrieval exam over a conclusions ledger: reachability verdicts, injection lane probe, use-stamp readout, forbidden-hit check (a superseded value must not win retrieval), ratchetable baseline, and a no-ledger survey mode for any repo.
artifacts.assumes: CONCLUSIONS.jsonl schema (see templates/CONCLUSIONS_TEMPLATE.md); survey mode assumes only markdown and a boot file.

artifacts.what: Three-tier runnable memory: working state, append-only episodes, semantic facts with asserted-vs-verified status. Verification refuses an empty oracle; compaction flushes down before shrinking; overwrites log the prior value as a supersession episode first; rejected values leave tombstones that block silent re-assertion; build_context takes an as-of cutoff to replay what the memory knew at a past moment.
Staleness auditor: classifies every ledger entry STALE / AGING / SPECIAL / OK against the live tree and checks supersession chains.

Pre-push collision check: behind-base, cross-branch file overlap, placeholder commit subjects, repeated base merges, stale session-state handoffs. A check that cannot run reports SKIPPED, never PASSED.
artifacts.assumes: git; other-branch data supplied as plain JSON.

artifacts.what: UserPromptSubmit hook injecting a same-turn capture reminder when a prompt contains ruling-shaped language.
artifacts.assumes: Claude Code hooks; register per templates/ledger-tools/capture-nudge.md.

artifacts.what: Lint guards (PII in fixtures, provenance narration, magic limits, raw view DDL, inline style/script, env vars outside config, unsourced authority citations) each shipped with fixtures proving it bites.
artifacts.assumes: Python repo conventions vary per guard; each guard's docstring states its own.

artifacts.what: Forward-only migration runner with an applied-state ledger and policy checks, with tests.
artifacts.assumes: Numbered SQL migration files; adapt the runner's paths.

artifacts.what: GitHub Actions templates around a fail-closed merge gate: automerge with an approval label, greenlight helpers, staging reset, branch auto-update, plus the gotchas doc that cost real debugging time.
artifacts.assumes: GitHub Actions; branch protection on the default branch.

artifacts.what: The rules-file skeleton: integrity floor, conventions, decision capture, continuity check, retro, writing rules. This repo's own CLAUDE.md is one filled-in instance.
artifacts.assumes: Any agent harness that loads a rules file.

artifacts.what: The append-only conclusions ledger format: path-keyed one-line JSON entries with evidence, provenance fields, and the dated supersession grammar.
artifacts.assumes: Nothing beyond a text editor; the ledger tools read this schema.

artifacts.what: Slash-command definitions (scout, retro, checkpoint, promote, ship, model-check, and more), each a workflow your agent runs on demand.
artifacts.assumes: Claude Code commands; adapt frontmatter for other harnesses.

artifacts.what: Harness-side hooks: pre-compact save, post-compact pointer, outbound PII screen, batch cadence, model routing.
artifacts.assumes: Claude Code hook events; each file names its own event.

artifacts.what: The standing-agent fleet kit: registry, boot packs, routine prompts, wake routing, the summon protocol, and the a2a task bus pattern.
artifacts.assumes: Scheduled agent runs (cron or platform routines); multi-session operation.

artifacts.what: In-process test harness skeleton for route-level tests without a server.

Paste-able rule sets for a rules file: session efficiency, data truth, flag lifecycle, regression layering, forward-only migrations, reuse-first, delivery protocol, propose-confirm-execute, adoption verifier.
artifacts.assumes: Each file states its own assumptions in its header.

artifacts.what: Operational checklists: continuity sweep, PR discipline, pre-push.

Pattern essays: the reasoning behind each artifact (memory measurement, floating memory, the chorus, context budgets, decision capture, the airport model, and more). Essays describe patterns; what ships is stated per essay.
How the pieces fit together: the operating model, coordinator seat model, scheduled agents, the unattended-agent contract.
